title: finding(plugin-gantt,plugin-kanban,plugin-calendar): three of the four overlay `navigation.mode` values collapse into the drawer — `modal` / `split` / `popover` all render the same Sheet, while `ObjectGrid` / `ObjectTree` honour them through the shared `NavigationOverlay`
body:
Measured statically while implementing objectui#7334 (route A: forwarding a gantt view's authored `navigation` down the view-schema path). Filed unassigned, not labelled. Part of no other card — objectui#7334 is about the key REACHING the component; this is about what the component does with the values once it arrives.

## Measured on `origin/main` `689953a`

The spec publishes seven `navigation.mode` values (`drawer`, `modal`, `split`, `popover`, `page`, `new_window`, `none`), and `@object-ui/components` ships one renderer that honours the four overlay ones — `NavigationOverlay`, whose own doc block spells the mapping out: drawer is a right-side Sheet, modal is a centre Dialog, split is a ResizablePanelGroup, popover is a popover card. It dispatches on `mode` at four separate branches.

**Two view renderers use it.** `ObjectGrid` and `ObjectTree` each render `NavigationOverlay` spread with their hook state, so an authored `modal` on a grid really is a Dialog.

**Three do not.** `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectKanban` and `ObjectCalendar` each compute the identical four-mode predicate

```
navConfig.mode === 'drawer' || navConfig.mode === 'modal' || navConfig.mode === 'split' || navConfig.mode === 'popover'
```

and then, on the true branch, render `RecordDetailDrawer` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` — which is a `Sheet`, unconditionally, with no `mode` prop at any of the three call sites. None of the three reads `navigation.mode` again after that predicate.

Net: on a gantt, a kanban board or a calendar, an author who writes `navigation: { mode: 'modal' }` (or `split`, or `popover`) gets the drawer. Three declared values render as a fourth, with no diagnostic. On a grid or a tree the same three values render as three different things.

## Why this is worth a card rather than a note

It is a declared key whose declared vocabulary is silently narrowed by the renderer, and the narrowing is **inconsistent across sibling surfaces** — so the same authored metadata means different things depending on which view type reads it. An author cannot discover the difference from the metadata, and the two halves of the product disagree about what the spec's own enum means.

It is also newly reachable on gantt: before objectui#7334 the gantt branch never received a `navigation` at all, so its three collapsed modes were unobservable. They are observable now.

## What is NOT claimed

Not driven in a browser. Nothing here says the remedy is "convert the three to `NavigationOverlay`" — `RecordDetailDrawer` carries record fetching, inline field save, lock handling and a full-page href that `NavigationOverlay` does not, so a straight swap is not obviously available and the right shape is a design question, not a mechanical one. Recording the measurement so the next person does not have to re-derive it.

Refs: objectui#7334 (where this was measured), objectui#7210, objectui#7222.
